notes: A fixture provider for the QNT-021 suite. Not a real feed: the names are invented to exercise the mapper's behaviour (a plain mapping, a sign flip, a deliberate exclusion, and — by omission — an item nobody has mapped). Entries are marked 'verified' because they are verified against the checked-in payload in tests/fixtures/provider_payload.py, which is the whole universe this table claims to describe.

entries.note: This fixture provider reports capex as a positive magnitude, so the entry flips it to the canonical outflow-negative convention.

The cash flow statement opens with the income-statement figure; mapping it here would create a second net_income for one filing. Note that the same provider name maps under 'income' and is excluded under 'cash_flow' — which is why the mapping key includes the statement.
